parameters.name: ModuleName
parameters.description:
设置访问策略的模块，取值：

- `Registry`：访问镜像仓库

- `Chart`：访问Helm Chart

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr delete-instance-endpoint-acl-policy --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --biz-endpoint-type internet --entry 127.0.0.1/32 --module-name Chart --entries example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr DeleteInstanceEndpointAclPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Entry '127.0.0.1/32' --InstanceId 'cri-xkx6vujuhay00000' --ModuleName Chart --EndpointType internet --Entries '["example-string"]'
